rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-bootstrap-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with `name` front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`.

The requirement obliges each link to specialized material to say when to read the file. The file has one real Markdown link, `[CI example](../habeas/references/ci.md)` in workflow step 9. It sits in the instruction to recommend separate collection and `habeas coverage-check` steps in project CI, so the reader is told to use it when making that recommendation.

The file also points to other skills' reference files in code spans, not as links. Each has its trigger stated beside it:
- `references/authoring-failures.md`: "If it fails, read…".
- `references/distributed-requirements.md`: when a convention applies on its own at many sites.
- `references/fixme.md`: when the user defers a possible bug.

No link lacks a stated condition, so I found no gap.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
